title: Bulk Product Operations
description: Learn how to perform bulk operations on multiple products at once, including bulk edit, delete, and status updates.
content:
Bulk Product Operations

Save time by performing actions on multiple products simultaneously using bulk operations.

Selecting Products

On the Products page, you can select products using:

  • Individual Selection: Click the checkbox next to each product
  • Select All: Use the checkbox in the table header to select all visible products
  • Select by Filter: Apply filters first, then select all filtered results

Available Bulk Operations

Bulk Edit

Edit multiple products at once:

  • Update prices
  • Change categories
  • Update stock quantities
  • Modify product status
  • Change tax settings
  • Update shipping settings

Bulk Delete

Delete multiple products at once. Be careful as this action cannot be undone.

Bulk Status Change

Quickly change status for multiple products:

  • Set to Active
  • Set to Inactive
  • Set to Draft

Bulk Category Assignment

Assign multiple products to one or more categories at once.

Bulk Tag Management

Add or remove tags from multiple products simultaneously.

Performing Bulk Actions

To perform a bulk action:

  1. Select the products you want to modify
  2. Click the "Bulk Actions" dropdown at the top
  3. Choose your desired action
  4. Configure the action settings
  5. Click "Apply" to execute

Bulk Import/Export

Manage large numbers of products using CSV files:

  • Export products to CSV
  • Edit in spreadsheet software
  • Import updated CSV
  • Validate data before import

Bulk Price Updates

Update prices for multiple products:

  • Set fixed price for all selected
  • Increase/decrease by percentage
  • Increase/decrease by fixed amount
  • Apply to regular or sale price

Best Practices

  • Always backup data before bulk operations
  • Test on a few products first
  • Review changes before confirming
  • Use filters to narrow down selections
  • Double-check selected products before applying

Limitations

Some operations have limits:

  • Maximum products per bulk operation: 500
  • Image uploads must be done individually
  • Complex customizations may require individual editing
